name: js
description: Eric's JavaScript and TypeScript standards plus the pre-commit checklist for JS/TS changes.

interface.longDescription: Use Eric JS in any JavaScript or TypeScript project. It covers package-manager and tooling defaults, and the pre-commit checklist for formatting, linting, type checking, tests, and unused code.
defaultPrompt: Use $javascript when creating or working in a JS/TS project.
Run $js-checklist before committing these TypeScript changes.
